name: wechaty-workspace
description: The Wechaty monorepo: the wechaty package and its core libraries, one npm workspace per package under packages/.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.lint:root: biome lint scripts && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bash -n scripts/*.sh && markdownlint packages/*/README.md
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit:deno: env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" CI="${CI:-}" deno test --no-check --allow-read=. --allow-run=git scripts && npm run test:unit:deno --workspaces
